decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings belong to the firm's core drainage families, and with no evidence that results fell short of aspirations, there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's strategic direction toward accessible, low-profile bathrooms, and the established firm's slack can carry it through uncertain results.
As the flagship designer drainage line it embodies the firm's design-quality positioning, so management would only drop it after clear negative feedback, and none has been observed.

The shower element with integrated slope complements the floor-level systems for renovation projects, and its modest visibility is not enough of a shortfall to justify withdrawal given the available slack.
The backflow-protected basement drain was actively promoted as a dedicated development and addresses a clear safety need, so it likely meets aspirations.
